id.description: Stable unique identifier for this action, used for dependency resolution and retries

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this action accomplishes

action_type.description: Canonical action category used by the orchestrator to determine execution strategy

dependencies.description: Action IDs that must complete successfully before this action can run

mcp_context.description: Specific MCP tool invocation context if this action requires an MCP server

tool_name.description: Specific tool to invoke on the MCP server

parameters.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP tool

required_inputs.description: Inputs required to perform this action

output.description: Expected result produced by the action if successful

error.description: Error message or diagnostic information if the action fails
